```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/coastwatch.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
overview = data.get("overview", [])
national = data.get("national", {})
west = data.get("west_coast", {})
erd = data.get("erd", {})

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def render_overview_card(item, index):
    return f"""
    <article class="cw-about-overview-card">

      <h2>{safe(item.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(item.get("description"))}</p>

    </article>
    """

def render_node(node):
    name = safe(node.get("name"))
    url = str(node.get("url") or "").strip()
    current = bool(node.get("current"))

    if current:
        return f"""
        <div class="cw-about-node current">
          <span class="cw-about-node-dot"></span>
          <span>{name}</span>
          <span class="cw-about-current-label">
            Current Node
          </span>
        </div>
        """

    if url:
        return f"""
        <a class="cw-about-node"
           href="{safe(url)}"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener noreferrer">

          <span class="cw-about-node-dot"></span>
          <span>{name}</span>
          <span class="cw-about-node-arrow"
                aria-hidden="true">↗</span>

        </a>
        """

    return f"""
    <div class="cw-about-node">
      <span class="cw-about-node-dot"></span>
      <span>{name}</span>
    </div>
    """

overview_html = "".join(
    render_overview_card(item, i)
    for i, item in enumerate(overview, start=1)
)

nodes_html = "".join(
    render_node(node)
    for node in national.get("nodes", [])
)

html = f"""
<div class="cw-about">

  <!-- HERO -->

  <section class="cw-about-hero">

    <div class="cw-about-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-about-hero-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- MISSION AND USERS -->

  <section class="cw-about-overview">

    <div class="cw-about-overview-grid">
      {overview_html}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- NATIONAL PROGRAM -->

  <section class="cw-about-section">

    <div class="cw-about-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-about-section-label">
        {safe(national.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(national.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(national.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-about-national-grid">

      <article class="cw-about-info-card">

        <div class="cw-about-info-card-header">
          <h3>{safe(national.get("central_title"))}</h3>
        </div>

        <div class="cw-about-richtext">
          {national.get("central_description", "")}
        </div>

      </article>

      <article class="cw-about-info-card">

        <div class="cw-about-info-card-header">
          <h3>{safe(national.get("regional_title"))}</h3>
        </div>

        <div class="cw-about-richtext">
          {national.get("regional_description", "")}
        </div>

      </article>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-about-network">

      <div class="cw-about-map">

        <img
          src="{safe(national.get("map_image"))}"
          alt="{safe(national.get("map_alt"))}"
          loading="lazy"
        >

      </div>

      <div class="cw-about-network-list">

        <h3>Explore CoastWatch Nodes</h3>

        <div class="cw-about-nodes">
          {nodes_html}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- WEST COAST NODE -->

  <section class="cw-about-feature">

    <div class="cw-about-feature-heading">

      <span class="cw-about-section-label">
        {safe(west.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(west.get("title"))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-about-richtext">
      {west.get("description", "")}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ERD -->

  <section class="cw-about-section cw-about-erd">

    <div class="cw-about-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-about-section-label">
        {safe(erd.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(erd.get("title"))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-about-richtext">
      {erd.get("description", "")}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
